description: Context OS lifecycle advisories. Deterministic mutation checks also run inside proposal/apply.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & (Join-Path $root 'scripts/context-os-hook.ps1') codex session-start"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & (Join-Path $root 'scripts/context-os-hook.ps1') codex pre-write"
